stem:
Meena lights a diya filled with ghee and places it in a closed steel box with no air holes. After a short time, the flame goes out.

Why did the flame go out?

options.text: The ghee was not a combustible substance.
The ghee did not reach its ignition temperature.
The supply of oxygen inside the closed box was used up.
The steel box absorbed the ghee from the diya.

teacher.key_rationale: Burning needs fuel, oxygen, and heat above the ignition temperature. Ghee is combustible and the flame already reached ignition temperature, so A and B fail; the closed box removes the oxygen supply, so the flame dies when oxygen is used up (C). D is irrelevant.
